lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 4 to 5 faint, low-contrast vertical white lines are visible on the dark grey torso; spacing is irregular with a wider gap between the mid-torso segments and the posterior segments.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The observed vertical lines are discontinuous, appearing as dashed or abbreviated segments that do not reach the ventral or dorsal boundaries of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 8 high-contrast white spots is located on the posterior haunch and upper hind limb; density is highest in the region directly above the stifle joint.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate spiral trajectory, initiating with a postero-lateral ascent from the skull before curving medially toward the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 2.8 times the pixel width of the horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tips represent approximately 18% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white dorsal crest/mane is visible along the spine from the neck to the rump; distinct white spots are visible on the lateral face below the orbital region.
